question:
Who is on the IT team I can escalate to? For each person, please share:
- Name and role
- Email address
- What types of issues they handle
- Their availability (e.g. on-call hours)

What are the top 5 most common support issues your employees face? For each:
- Issue description
- Standard resolution steps
- Any tools or system access required to fix it
What types of issues should I treat as P1 (immediate escalation)? Examples: security incidents, system-wide outages, data loss. List anything specific to your org.
What IT systems and tools does your company use? (e.g. VPN client, SSO provider, MDM, ticketing system, cloud provider). This helps me give accurate instructions.
When should I ask you to review my support replies before sending?

options.label: Always — review every reply before it goes out
Only for sensitive or high-stakes replies (escalations, security issues)

question: Any email addresses or domains I should always auto-approve without review? One per line — use `@domain.com` for whole domains.

What tone should I use in support replies? Any preferences on:
- Formal vs casual
- Length (brief vs detailed)
- Signature format
- Any phrases or formats to avoid
